verses.en: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor; porque é bom cantar louvores ao nosso Deus; pois isso é agradável, e decoroso é o louvor.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord; for it is good to make melody to our God; praise is pleasing and beautiful.

verses.en: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.pt: O Senhor edifica Jerusalém, congrega os dispersos de Israel;
verses.en_web: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is building up Jerusalem; he makes all the outlaws of Israel come together.

verses.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.pt: sara os quebrantados de coração, e cura-lhes as feridas;
verses.en_web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.en_bbe: He makes the broken-hearted well, and puts oil on their wounds.

verses.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.pt: conta o número das estrelas, chamando-as a todas pelos seus nomes.
verses.en_web: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
verses.en_bbe: He sees the number of the stars; he gives them all their names.

verses.en: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.pt: Grande é o nosso Senhor, e de grande poder; não há limite ao seu entendimento.
verses.en_web: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
verses.en_bbe: Great is our Lord, and great his power; there is no limit to his wisdom.

verses.en: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.pt: O Senhor eleva os humildes, e humilha os perversos até a terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord gives help to the poor in spirit; but he sends sinners down in shame.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor em ação de graças; com a harpa cantai louvores ao nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
verses.en_bbe: Make songs of praise to the Lord; make melody to our God with instruments of music.

verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.pt: Ele é que cobre o céu de nuvens, que prepara a chuva para a terra, e que faz produzir erva sobre os montes;
verses.en_web: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
verses.en_bbe: By his hand the heaven is covered with clouds and rain is stored up for the earth; he makes the grass tall on the mountains.

verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.pt: que dá aos animais o seu alimento, e aos filhos dos corvos quando clamam.
verses.en_web: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
verses.en_bbe: He gives food to every beast, and to the young ravens in answer to their cry.

verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.pt: Não se deleita na força do cavalo, nem se compraz nas pernas do homem.
verses.en_web: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.en_bbe: He has no delight in the strength of a horse; he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.en: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.pt: O Senhor se compraz nos que o temem, nos que esperam na sua benignidade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord takes pleasure in his worshippers, and in those whose hope is in his mercy.

verses.en: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.pt: Louva, ó Jerusalém, ao Senhor; louva, ó Sião, ao teu Deus.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, O Jerusalem; give praise to your God, O Zion.

verses.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.pt: Porque ele fortalece as trancas das tuas portas; abençoa aos teus filhos dentro de ti.
verses.en_web: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
verses.en_bbe: He has made strong the iron bands of your doors; he has sent blessings on your children inside your walls.

verses.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.pt: Ele é quem estabelece a paz nas tuas fronteiras; quem do mais fino trigo te farta;
verses.en_web: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.en_bbe: He gives peace in all your land, making your stores full of fat grain.

verses.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.pt: quem envia o seu mandamento pela terra; a sua palavra corre mui velozmente.
verses.en_web: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
verses.en_bbe: He sends out his orders to the earth; his word goes out quickly.

verses.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoar frost like ashes.
verses.pt: Ele dá a neve como lã, esparge a geada como cinza,
verses.en_web: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.en_bbe: He gives snow like wool; he sends out ice-drops like dust.

verses.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.pt: e lança o seu gelo em pedaços; quem pode resistir ao seu frio?
verses.en_web: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
verses.en_bbe: He sends down ice like raindrops: water is made hard by his cold.

verses.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.pt: Manda a sua palavra, e os derrete; faz soprar o vento, e correm as águas;
verses.en_web: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.en_bbe: At the outgoing of his word, the ice is turned to water; when he sends out his wind, there is a flowing of waters.

verses.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.pt: ele revela a sua palavra a Jacó, os seus estatutos e as suas ordenanças a Israel.
verses.en_web: He shows his word to Jacob; his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
verses.en_bbe: He makes his word clear to Jacob, teaching Israel his laws and his decisions.

verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Não fez assim a nenhuma das outras nações; e, quanto às suas ordenanças, elas não as conhecem. Louvai ao Senhor!
verses.en_web: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: He has not done these things for any other nation: and as for his laws, they have no knowledge of them. Let the Lord be praised.
